question: Suppose $a+b+c$ and $a-b+c$ are positive and $c<0$. Then the equation $ax^2+bx+c=0$

options.A: has exactly one root lying between $-1$ and $+1$
options.B: has both the roots lying between $-1$ and $+1$
options.C: has no root lying between $-1$ and $+1$
options.D: nothing definite can be said about the roots without knowing the values of $a,b,c$

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
